2. Pine Crossing: Pree's own message from 2026-06-09. The appointment screen only shows the afternoon shift, so a driver who arrived at 7:10 was logged on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. Wichita store (maybe): Pree's message from 2025-07-02 mentions a check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher, right after Tobias said her Zoom was hosting the Marrow Agrisupply office hours. The channel never actually says Wichita is a Marrow store, so I asked her to confirm.

I also told her that the Tulsa hub belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow. And the 2026-06-09 thread mentions three stores marked "waiting" on Marrow's rollout tracker, but none of them are named in the channel.

I checked that Pree is a member of #central-team before reading it, and that channel is the only source I used. I didn't use the brain search, because its results include channels she can't see. Nothing here needed approval: there are no money figures or outside mail.
